verdict.line: You lose trades level 1-5 if Jayce forces all-ins with Hammer Q-E; you win the lane if you hit level 6 with Q stacks banked and he's out of mana.

brief.thesis: Jayce's Hammer Stance owns short trades with To the Skies! (16/14/12/10/8s cooldown, melee leap) into Thundering Blow knockback, but neither tool touches you from outside 240-600 range if you respect his cooldowns. Nasus wins this matchup on the clock: the 55.8% win rate over 274 games says that once Wither and Fury of the Sands come online, Jayce's burst stops being lethal and your Q stacks start being a second health bar.

theirWindow.when: Hammer Stance, Q and E both up
theirWindow.what: He can leap in with Q (To the Skies!) then knock you back with E (Thundering Blow) for a full trade. Don't stand still at max range when both show no charge-depleted animation; back off until one is on cooldown.

yourWindow.when: He's in Cannon Stance or just leapt
yourWindow.what: Cannon Stance has no gap closer, so walk up and land Q (Siphoning Strike, 8-4s cooldown) for free. If he just used Hammer Q to leap in, his E knockback is his only follow-up — eat it and keep swinging, since he can't re-engage until Q comes off cooldown.

start.why: 60% win rate over 185 games; the flat damage reduction on the first attack from Jayce's Hammer poke matters more than the ring's mana you don't need as Nasus.

boots.why: 60.8% win rate over 130 games; the autoattack damage reduction directly cuts Jayce's basic-attack poke and his Cannon Stance Hyper Charge bursts.

core.why: 62.5% win rate over 32 games on this build path; the damage proc rewards landing stacked Q's on him once he's in range.
Ability Haste shortens your Wither and Spirit Fire cooldowns, letting you reapply the Attack Speed slow before he can reposition.
Stacks with Soul Eater lifesteal to win extended trades once Wither is on him and he can't kite.

situational.when: he's building full lethality and out-damaging your sustain in trades
you need the Spirit Fire-adjacent slow uptime for a tankier frontline role
you need to close the gap on a kiting Jayce in Cannon Stance

runes.keystoneWhy: 56.2% win rate on this page; the heal and Move Speed proc covers the exact window where you're walking into Hammer Q range and need to survive the return trade.

summoners.why: 56.6% win rate, the highest of the three spell pairs on record; Ghost closes the gap on a kiting Jayce in Cannon Stance and Teleport lets you keep farming jungle camps for Q stacks without giving up lane presence.

playing.title: Farm Q stacks on jungle camps early
playing.detail: Siphoning Strike's stack bonus is permanent once it kills, so use the 8-4s cooldown on wolves and raptors between waves whenever Jayce has poke range on you in lane.

playing.title: Never approach with both his skills up
playing.detail: If Hammer Stance Q and E both show no cooldown overlay, stay outside 600 range; walking in invites the leap-knockback combo for free damage.

playing.title: Punish Cannon Stance commitments
playing.detail: Cannon Stance has zero gap-closing tools, so any time he swaps to it to poke with Shock Blast, close the distance and land Q before he can swap back.

playing.title: Wither the instant he commits to a fight
playing.detail: W (Wither)'s Attack and Move Speed decay (15-11s cooldown) is your only tool to stop him kiting once he's chosen to trade; fire it the moment he's inside your melee range.

playing.title: Hold Fury of the Sands for forced fights, not pokes
playing.detail: R's 120s cooldown is too long to waste on a skirmish you can walk away from; save it for the all-in post-level 6 that OP.GG's own data flags as your kill window.

playing.title: Drop Spirit Fire under him before committing
playing.detail: E's Armor reduction on the zone turns your subsequent Q's and autos into real damage output, so place it before, not during, an all-in.

playing.title: Trade through Thundering Blow, don't avoid it
playing.detail: The knockback only displaces you a short distance and deals magic damage; it doesn't end the fight, so keep walking back in and swinging rather than disengaging.

brief.patchCaveat: Win rates, build paths, runes, and summoner spells above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning and trade-timing advice are this coach's own read of the ability kit.

stats.opponentTip: Always keep some distance to avoid being punished by Jayce. Focus foremost on raising your [Q] stacks, and try go in for the kill post-level 6 with Unsealed Spellbook + Fury of the Sands [R] when enemy skills are on cooldown.
